title: World History Atlas v5 cited-page index

scope.included: The 78 original essays added in v5 and the separate targeted China display review overlay: 2 event reviews and 24 chronicle-stop annotations.
scope.excluded: Older atlas narrative, the full inherited Jiangshan event/profile/place collections and their general provenance, cartographic sources, uncited research candidates, and full essay or review text. The frozen upstream chronicle is included only where it is directly cited by an annotation.
scope.evidenceMeaning: An index entry records a cited page and its use, not independent corroboration of every claim. Evidence notes and consultation limits remain in the cited record or review. Internal checks against inherited source text are distinct from external historical corroboration.
scope.deduplication: Exact cited URL strings. Distinct paths, query strings and fragments remain distinct; publisher identity does not imply independent authorship.
scope.identity: recordIds are the 78 essay IDs in history.json. reviewIds are index labels: event:<recordId> or chronicle:<journeyId>/<stopId>; reviewTargets resolves them to the overlay objects.
scope.sourceIndexConvention: sourceIndex and reviewIndex are zero-based array positions. uses links each indexed URL to the original sources array without copying its prose.
scope.pathConvention: Paths in this document are relative to docs/V5_SOURCE_INDEX.json.
scope.licensing: This bibliography does not change content licenses. Original prose and inherited Jiangshan material retain the distinctions documented in CONTENT_LICENSE.md.
